verdict.rationale: smolagents exposes memory introspection (agent.replay(), memory access) and supports running agents step-by-step via agent.step(memory_step) for long-running tool calls, plus push_to_hub/from_hub to persist and reload an agent's state — building blocks that could support resuming a run. However there is no documented explicit checkpoint/resume-after-crash mechanism or guarantee that a run resumes exactly where it left off. Missing for 10: explicit crash-recovery/checkpoint API, automatic state persistence on failure, and verified evidence of resuming mid-run after an actual crash.
